note: Hand-curated, sourced entries. Two-way race: Republican incumbent vs. independent, no Democratic nominee; a reminder the app matches on policy, never party.

NE-senate.statusNote: Sen. Pete Ricketts (R) faces independent union leader Dan Osborn, who qualified for the November ballot by petition. Democrat Cindy Burbank won her primary but withdrew in July, and the state Democratic Party voted Aug 23 not to name a replacement, so no Democrat is on the ballot. Legal Marijuana NOW nominee Mike Marvin suspended his campaign and endorsed Osborn but remains on the ballot.

NE-house-2.statusNote: Open seat with Rep. Don Bacon (R) not running: Brinker Harding (R) faces Denise Powell (D) and Libertarian Eric Foreman, nominees set in the May 12, 2026 primary. Positions researched and stored, race not scored, overlap 0 of 10 as of Aug 29, 2026.

NE-house-1.statusNote: Rep. Mike Flood (R) seeks re-election against former diplomat Chris Backemeyer (D) and Libertarian Nik Sandman. Flood was unopposed in the May 12, 2026 Republican primary and Backemeyer won the Democratic primary with 57% over Eric Moyer. Independent Austin Ahlman suspended his campaign on July 19 and is not on the ballot. Positions researched and stored, race not scored, overlap 0 of 10 as of Aug 29, 2026.
